Display Gran Alegria (Winter Tracksuit)
Display Loves Only You (Winter Tracksuit)
Display Marche Lorraine (Winter Tracksuit) holding puppet (prop7002_00)
Gran is skipping
――Yes... Thank you very much for your guidance.

That's why they're so easy to use in flower arrangements.
Adding sweet peas creates movement and brings an instant touch of brilliance.
(But――I hesitate to do that...)
(I can't go outside either――all I can do is wait for an opening up front...)

(――Red roses. Passionate flowers, just like Loves-san.
They have such a strong presence, yet when bound with other flowers――they blend in exquisite harmony.)

Oh, you're always so considerate. It's just like you, Bouquet-chan, but...
everyone's used to it. With that much space, they expect you to push through!

(――I can't match their passion. I only create dissonance.
............Maybe I should give up――)

No, I'm just sharing some of the classroom flowers
with the Trainer break room, so――um, you're very welcome.

...Hehe, it's all thanks to the flowers and the coffee.
They're so warm――they even helped my heart unwind.
How wonderful... I want to become part of a bouquet together with everyone, too.

(Yet――I can't push forward. I can't aggressively race for the win――
Maybe I'm disrupting the "harmony" of the race...)

It should be about time for the pansies to bloom, too――
Let's move them somewhere with plenty of sunlight.

(――Did they talk to me because they saw how troubled I was?
Could this coffee be... for that reason too?)
――――, ――Now! Hyaaaah!

(The pace is a bit fast. At this rate, the final stretch will be tough.
I can't let myself get swept up; I must keep my own pace――)
Yes... Thank you both for your kindness.

Right? ♪ Gran-chan isn't the only one
who was looking forward to today's mock race!

This is, like, my personal rule!
Whenever I'm itching to run, I skip!

I'm sorry, that's not it at all! It's simply an issue with my own mindset――
The thought crossed my mind that cutting in might cause trouble for everyone...

...Oh, the roses I brought the day before yesterday are still blooming so beautifully.
I'll arrange them with the flowers I brought today――perhaps the red ones would look best in the center.

Gran-chan, if you keep skipping like that,
won't you wear yourself out before the race even starts?
I won't let you dictate the pace. I'll mark you and apply pressure...!

L-Love-chan is right...! 
Besides, that's just how races... how competitions work.

(Both flowers and races. When individual colors harmonize, their brilliance multiplies.
I truly love that special beauty.)

Hehe, Curren-chan and everyone else are shining so brightly.
In a race, everyone comes together as one――just like a bouquet of flowers.

――Yes. I will run with everything I have.
Let's both have a great race.

(I'm so happy... That Trainer always takes the time to thank me.
Not only did they notice the flowers――they said it brought them comfort.)

――Excuse me, do you have a moment?
There's a favor I'd like to ask――

――The Snow Princesses are in full bloom.
Hehe, a magnificent pure white. The tiny blossoms bunch together like little pom-poms.

"Whoa, someone's super fired up~!
But Maru-chan and Love-chan did secret special training too, you know!"

Hehehe, how lovely. I hope lots of people come to admire you.
――Ah. Sparkling in the morning light...――

Even from the far outside, I can still catch up and win!!
Hyaaaaaaaaaah!

Everyone seems to be in top form, even for a mock race.
L-Let's do our best so we don't get overwhelmed...!

Maru-chan is taking the inside, huh.
――In that case, I'll take the outside!

Ah! I-I'm so sorry! I'm completely fine...――
I'll rearrange the flowers right away! ――And change the water, too!

――Watering complete. Next is――the flowers for the classroom.
Please share just a few roses with me.

(From both sides――! Ugh... the front is closing up fast.
Forcing my way in there would be... Then, to the outside――)

U-Um... Bouquet-san, I'm sorry...
Did I... put too much pressure on you...?

(Competing fiercely to seize victory.
Squeezing through gaps to secure a path――that, too, is part of competition.)

Alright, next up, Group D!
...Okay, all loaded in the gates!

――Excuse me. Um, Trainers,
would it be alright if I changed the water in the vases?
It's like a small, golden bouquet, isn't it?

Yes, exactly. The fluttering petals look just like frills, don't they?
Hehehe, so gorgeous and lovely.

Hmm-hmm-mm~♪ The mock race we've been waiting for is finally here!
I can't wait for our turn!

(――I managed to take a forward position.
Chrono-san is nearby, and――Loves-san and the others are at the back.)

(Individual passions clash together to create the "harmony" of a race.
Captivated by the harmony shown by Curren-chan and the others――I began running.)

Go, Curren-chan, go~! Wow, she's so fast...!
Come on, come on, just a little more...! ――Yay, she won!

(Graceful roses, and frilly sweet peas.
When their individual traits are bound in harmony――a cheerfully dancing bouquet is born.)

Bouquet-san, whenever you see an opening big enough for one person, you have to seize it immediately.
You need the drive to carve out your own space! That spirit is what will lead to victory!

――Coffee, and tea snacks as well...
Is it truly alright for me to accept all of this?

And then―― Oh. The sweet peas are already blooming.
If I arrange them together, it will look gorgeous. For the color―― perhaps white would be nice.
